name: 暖光卡片
description: 秋日暖橙 #d97758 强调，暖白底+卡片布局+方格纹理+暖光阴影，适合深度文章、情感随笔

styles.h1: font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; color: #4a413d; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.3; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(74,65,61,0.3);
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #d97758; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(74,65,61,0.3); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 16px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; color: #d97758; border-bottom: 2px solid #d97758; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.3; display: inline-block;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #4a413d; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 5px solid #d97758; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef4e7, #fff8f0); margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 15px; color: #4a413d; line-height: 1.75; font-style: italic; box-shadow: inset 0 0 15px rgba(217,119,88,0.1); border: 2px solid #d97758;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #4a413d; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-style: normal; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 14px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(217,119,88,0.15); background: #ffffff; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 1px; background: rgba(74,65,61,0.1); border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(217,119,88,0.1); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 90%; color: #c06b4d; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
styles.pre: background: #faf9f5; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; border-top: 3px solid #d97758; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(217,119,88,0.1); color: #4a413d; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; background: #f0ede8;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #4a413d; font-size: 14px; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 14px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(217,119,88,0.08);
styles.th: background: rgba(217,119,88,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(74,65,61,0.1); text-align: left; font-weight: bold; color: #4a413d;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: rgba(217,119,88,0.12); color: #d97758; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #4a413d; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #999999; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
